data.description:
## Summary

`scripts/check_uv_pin.py` enforces exact image pinning, but its file discovery at line 400
is `root.glob("**/Dockerfile*")`. Compose files are never examined, so every `image:` key in
a `docker-compose*.yml` is unguarded — including the `:latest` tag the gate's own docstring
says must never appear.

## Evidence

The gate's stated contract (line 16): "no Dockerfile image may use `:latest`". Its discovery
(line 400): `for path in root.glob("**/Dockerfile*")`.

Tracked compose files and their `image:` keys:

- `docker-compose.langfuse.yml:113` — `docker.io/minio/minio:latest` — a literal `:latest`,
  the exact string the gate exists to reject.
- `docker-compose.langfuse.yml:92` — `docker.io/clickhouse/clickhouse-server:24.3` — floating patch.
- `docker-compose.langfuse.yml:133` — `docker.io/redis:7` — floating minor and patch.
- `docker-compose.langfuse.yml:149` — `docker.io/postgres:${POSTGRES_VERSION:-17}` — floating minor and patch.
- `docker-compose.langfuse.yml:25` and `:70` — `langfuse` images behind a `${LANGFUSE_IMAGE_TAG:-3.186.0}`
  default, which the gate treats as unprovable when it appears in a Dockerfile build ARG.

`infra/compose/docker-compose.yml` and `tests/external/live_jira_dc/docker-compose.yml`
declare no `image:` keys today, so the gap is currently latent in those 2 files and live in 1.

## Why this matters

This is the mechanism by which bug `6d98-28f4-946a-4016` reached `main` and stayed there: a
floating tag in a compose file drifted, and no gate could see it. Fixing 6d98 pins that one
line; it does not stop the next one. The gate advertises a guarantee it only delivers for
Dockerfiles, so the compose surface looks covered and is not.

Deliberately scoped to detection only. Re-pinning the 4 floating tags above is separate work
with its own compatibility questions, and pinning them here would couple a gate change to 4
dependency upgrades.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Image-pin discovery examines tracked Compose files in addition to `Dockerfile*`.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` key using the `:latest` tag fails the gate.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` key carrying no tag fails the gate.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` key pinned to an exact tag passes the gate.
- [ ] A Compose `image:` key pinned by digest passes the gate.
- [ ] The failure message names the Compose file and the offending image reference.
- [ ] The gate's docstring describes the Compose surface it now covers.
- [ ] A regression test covers a Compose file with a `:latest` image.
- [ ] A regression test covers a Compose file with an exactly-pinned image.
- [ ] The 4 currently-floating tags in `docker-compose.langfuse.yml` are either pinned in
      this change or recorded as an explicit, justified allowance that the gate honours by
      name rather than by kind.
data.title: Image-pin gate only globs Dockerfile*, leaving every Compose image: key unguarded
